about: The main window's collections: people (address book), sign-in accounts, teams, the rota and availability, meetings, pastoral visits, care, prayer, permissions and settings. The format is the one described in events.json. Read by tools/data-map-build.mjs (into functions/data-map.json), by the server's tidying after a delete (functions/data-links.js) and by orphanSweep (functions/orphan-sweep.js).

addressBook.what: A person in the church's address book.

links.why: People are archived, never deleted; erasure goes through the privacy tools.

users.what: A sign-in account: its person, teams, admin areas and status.

teams.what: A team or group: its name, colour, rota flag, parent and what it covers.

events.what: A rota date: a service or a meeting, its teams, roles and people.

links.why: Teams are archived, never deleted; old terms are archived by Data tools, not deleted.

meetings.what: A meeting's private part: title, notes, organiser and the people invited by name.

links.why: Half of the meeting; without its rota event it means nothing.
The meeting still happens if its organiser's account closes; a master admin can host it.

meetingGuests.what: A guest's link to one meeting (only its hash), their name and email.

links.why: A guest link to a meeting that is gone must stop working and not keep an outsider's address.

meetingSends.what: Who was emailed about a meeting, so a cancellation reaches the same people.

links.why: Only needed while the meeting exists.

availability.what: One person's answer for one rota date: available, unavailable or maybe.

links.why: An answer for a date no longer on the rota means nothing.

availabilityRequests.what: A term's request for availability: its dates and when it closes.

rotaExceptions.what: Leave to put a person on the rota despite a missing check, with the reason.

rotaSignoff.what: A team's sign-off of a term's rota (id: term__team).

pastoralVisits.what: A pastoral visit: who was visited (name copied in), when, by whom, follow-up.

links.why: People are archived, never deleted; the visit keeps the name it was made with.

pastoralReminded.what: A follow-up reminder already sent for a visit (id: visit_followUp).

links.why: It only stops a reminder being sent twice for that visit.

worries.what: "I'm worried about someone": a care or safeguarding concern, who it is about and who dealt with it.

links.why: People are archived, never deleted; a concern follows the retention rules.

prayers.what: A prayer request and its answer (the name it was sent with copied in).

links.why: The request was shared with the prayer team; it stays as they saw it.

prayerAnswers.what: An answered-prayer story shared with the church.

prayerSundayList.what: The prayer list for one Sunday (id: the date).

permissionExceptions.what: A permission given to or taken from one person, with why and until when.

links.why: An exception for a closed account must not apply to anyone.

permissionsLog.what: Who changed whose permissions, and how.

links.why: People are archived, never deleted; an audit log is kept.

notifyPrefs.what: An account's notification choices and quiet hours.

pushTokens.what: A device registered for an account's notifications.

links.why: A closed account's devices must stop being sent anything.

calendarKeys.what: An account's private calendar feed keys.

calendarFeeds.what: One private calendar feed: whose it is and what it shows.

links.why: A closed account's feed must stop working.

teamContent.what: A team's home-page panels (id: the team).

teamMailboxes.what: Who reads a team's shared email (id: the team).

hubPages.what: A page on the hub's menu: its title, link and the team it belongs to.

careRouting.what: Where care, pastoral and prayer messages go.

prayerSettings.what: Who the prayer team is and how prayer requests work.

churchSettings.what: The church's settings, one document per area (details, services, video, features...).

orphanSweeps.what: What the nightly orphan check found and fixed (id: the date).
